data.name: critical
text:
kick (critical)
page: MOR-009_DDR_2019-04-12.pdf#p1
cause: Flow-check positive, pit gain of 118 bbl and flow-out exceeding flow-in while in Tipam.
remedy: Shut in well, closed BOP, circulated kill mud per driller's method.
NPT: 8.61 h

text:

page: MOR-009_DDR_2019-04-12.pdf#p1

remedy: Raised mud weight in 72-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
